address: Le Negresco, 37 promenade des Anglais, Nice, 06000, France
bio: The rotunda-shaped brasserie of the legendary luxury hotel has resolutely entered the modern world. In this light-filled space (with a terrace), you choose from a menu (designed by Michelin-starred chef Virginie Basselot) that celebrates a flavoursome and colourful cuisine full of Mediterranean flair, with nods to Nice's traditions....
